data.narrative:
Kodiak AI is a Series C-stage frontier-tech company in the Defense & Security sector, which has raised $250M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 12 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Quantum-Systems, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x to the $250M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $425M. The peer-median method references a 12-company cohort with a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range spanning $300M (floor) to $18.0B (ceiling, representing Helsing at Series D). The wide peer range—driven by outliers like Quantum-Systems at $8.0B and Chaos Industries at $4.5B—reflects material dispersion in the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Synthesizing these approaches yields a triangulated range of $361M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.1B. The stage-progression method produces a more conservative result, while peer-median carries greater weight given company-level visibility. Key uncertainties include (1) relative product maturity and commercial traction versus peers, (2) sensitivity to defense budget cycles, and (3) whether Kodiak's positioning aligns with the higher-valuation or lower-valuation segment of the peer set.
